supervisory_authorities.dpa: Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada (OPC)
supervisory_authorities.csirt: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security (CCCS / CSE)

statutory_frameworks.official_title: An Act respecting cyber security, amending the Telecommunications Act and making consequential amendments to other Acts (Bill C-26 / CCSPA)
statutory_frameworks.supervisory_authority: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security (CCCS / CSE) / Minister of Public Safety

metadata.mandate: Requires designated vital operators to establish Cyber Security Programs (CSPs) within 90 days, mitigate supply chain risks, and report cyber incidents to CSE within 72 hours.

statutory_frameworks.official_title: Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) as modernized by Digital Charter Implementation Act (Bill C-27 / CPPA)
statutory_frameworks.supervisory_authority: Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada (OPC)

metadata.adequacy: Maintains reciprocal adequacy with European Union

cyber_security_mandates.target_domain: Critical Cyber Systems (Energy, Telecom, Finance, Transport)
cyber_security_mandates.baseline_standard_ref: CCCS Cyber Security Audit Framework / ITSG-33 / IEC 62443
cyber_security_mandates.mandatory_certifications: Mandatory written Cyber Security Program (CSP) approved by designated regulator; third-party supply chain audits
cyber_security_mandates.details: CCSPA Section 15 requires vital operators to identify cyber risks arising from products, services, and supply chains, with binding ministerial orders to disconnect non-compliant high-risk vendor equipment.

data_privacy_sovereignty.primary_privacy_law: Data Protection and Privacy Act of Canada
data_privacy_sovereignty.supervisory_dpa: Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada (OPC)
data_privacy_sovereignty.localization_scope: Sector-specific financial and government data localization where applicable.

cryptography_controls.crypto_export_controls: National Customs & Dual-Use Export Control Regime.
cryptography_controls.post_quantum_mandate: Monitoring international standard bodies (ISO/IEC JTC 1 / ITU-T).

incident_disclosure_rules.breach_type: Critical Cyber Incident Affecting Vital System
recipient_authorities: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security (CCCS / CSE)
incident_disclosure_rules.threshold_trigger_definition: Any cybersecurity incident that interferes or could interfere with the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of a critical cyber system.

sector_applicability.specific_obligations: Generation, transmission, distribution, and pipeline SCADA integrity.
Water treatment, distribution telemetry, and environmental control.
Hospital systems, medical device cybersecurity, and EHR data protection.
Payment systems, banking core networks, and cyber resilience audits.
Public telecommunications networks, submarine cables, and 5G security.
Machinery safety, industrial robotics, PLC programming, and safety instrumented systems.
Rail signaling, air traffic management, maritime port terminals, and connected vehicles.
